references.text: Jazer is first mentioned in the list of cities that the tribes of Gad and Reuben wanted as their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan.
Jazer was conquered by the Israelites under Moses' leadership when they took possession of the land of the Amorites.
Jazer is mentioned as part of the inheritance of the tribe of Gad when the land was divided under Joshua.
Jazer was given to the Levites as one of their cities from the tribe of Gad.
The prophet Isaiah mentions Jazer in a lament over Moab, showing the city's continued significance.
